question: Knight of the Mists says that when it enters I may pay {U}, and if I don't, I destroy target Knight. Can the Knight I destroy belong to an opponent?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it can destroy an opponent's Knight.

whyHard: The effect reads as a drawback, so players assume the target must be their own Knight.
